title: pultenaea cunninghamii
intro: Pultenaea cunninghamii, commonly known as the Spotted Bush Pea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is a shrub native to eastern Australia, known for its small yellow flowers and distinctive spotted leaves. The Spotted Bush Pea has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Pultenaea cunninghamii include glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
